Version 0.3.2 adds separate small-file and bulk transfer lanes, bounded scan-to-send caching, persistent chunk indexes and adaptive delta selection. Small edits can proceed while a bulk transfer is blocked. Defaults are three negotiated lanes and 64 MiB for each cache; the RAM cache captures files up to 8 MiB. Larger or evicted files retain the normal read path. Durability, source-change checks and causal conflict preservation remain enforced.

Offline pairing now supports receiver metadata export, merge/seed-local previews, paginated review and explicit source baseline application. New independent receiver edits remain protected. Archive retention supports dry runs, age/space limits and separately opt-in automatic cleanup; it is disabled by default and protects pending conflicts and active transfers.

The TUI layout is unchanged. JSON diagnostics expose read reuse and delta work. Local benchmark samples and their limitations are recorded in VALIDATION.md; these changes do not promise a universal throughput gain.

**Wire protocol 5 requires both peers to upgrade together.** Stop both services, run `brew update && brew upgrade ysync` on each machine, then restart both services and monitors. Cargo users can install tag `v0.3.2`. Existing identities, indexed versions and resumable payloads are retained. The first upgraded startup builds partial change indexes over the existing entries. Experimental prerelease.
